button-primary.note: Button face 64 px tall + lip. Sprite Swap: normal → pressed.

button-primary-pressed.note: Button face 64 px tall + lip. Sprite Swap: normal → pressed.

button-secondary.note: Button face 64 px tall + lip. Sprite Swap: normal → pressed.

button-secondary-pressed.note: Button face 64 px tall + lip. Sprite Swap: normal → pressed.

button-danger.note: Button face 64 px tall + lip. Sprite Swap: normal → pressed.

button-danger-pressed.note: Button face 64 px tall + lip. Sprite Swap: normal → pressed.

button-success.note: Button face 64 px tall + lip. Sprite Swap: normal → pressed.

button-success-pressed.note: Button face 64 px tall + lip. Sprite Swap: normal → pressed.

button-disabled.note: Button face 64 px tall + lip. Sprite Swap: normal → pressed.

button-disabled-pressed.note: Button face 64 px tall + lip. Sprite Swap: normal → pressed.

button-next.note: Kepler bubble Next button, 50 px tall.

loss-sticker.note: Cost sticker on a button: put a 26 px icon + Luckiest Guy 19 number inside.

panel.note: Header-band panel: 58 px header on top (do not stretch it vertically), white body stretches.

banner-day.note: Toy pill banner, 84 px tall: stretch horizontally only. Icon breaks out on the left.

banner-alert.note: Toy pill banner, 84 px tall: stretch horizontally only. Icon breaks out on the left.

ribbon-plate.note: Achievement plate: stretch horizontally only. Tails behind it, star on top, rays behind the star.

ribbon-tail-left.note: Simple sprite, 34 px outside the plate, 24 px below its top.

ribbon-tail-right.note: Simple sprite, 34 px outside the plate, 24 px below its top.

rays.note: Simple sprite behind the star; rotate one turn per 8 s.

bubble-tail.note: Simple sprite, overlap the bubble's left edge by 6 px, 30 px above its bottom.

name-plate.note: Kepler name plate: stretch horizontally only.

kepler.note: Kepler at 256 (512 px PNG). Simple sprite.

hud-track-low.note: Track with the loss outline, for a low resource.

hud-fill-power.note: Power fill, already colored: width = value / capacity, under a RectMask2D.

hud-fill-water.note: Water fill, already colored: width = value / capacity, under a RectMask2D.

hud-fill-food.note: Food fill, already colored: width = value / capacity, under a RectMask2D.

hud-fill-parts.note: Parts fill, already colored: width = value / capacity, under a RectMask2D.

hud-shine.note: Shine at the fill end when the fill is 45-60% long.
